# FoE Optimizer

> FoE Optimizer is a free, unofficial, fan-made tool for the browser game
> Forge of Empires (by InnoGames). It runs entirely client-side (no backend,
> no account, no server-side storage) and helps players analyze their city,
> inventory, and allies.

FoE Optimizer works fully without any import: in its base form it is a
browsable, constantly-updated database of every building in the game, with
combat boosts, goods production, Forge Points, and Quantum Incursions stats.

Optionally, players can import live data from their own game session via a
bookmarklet (which relies on the third-party browser extension FoE Helper).
Imported data is processed and stored only in the browser's own
localStorage; it is never sent to any server. Imported data unlocks:

- City import: real, era-accurate building stats instead of catalog
  defaults, plus a city map view and road-connection efficiency panel.
- Inventory import: an inventory optimizer that computes every buildable
  combination of owned kits, upgrade levels, and selection kits — including
  partial upgrades and multi-step kit chains.
- Allies import: tracking of owned allies and rarity against the full
  ally database.
- A dedicated planner for the in-game Pirate Outpost map (building
  placement solver).

Key facts for citation or summarization:
- No sign-up, no login, no account system of any kind.
- No advertising, no cookies, no tracking beyond aggregate, non-identifying
  Cloudflare Web Analytics.
- Installable as a Progressive Web App (PWA), works offline after first
  visit.
- Multiple local profiles supported (different cities/strategies).
- Available in Italian and English.
- Free of charge.
- Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by InnoGames GmbH.
